meta.name: EPCOT — Walt Disney World, Orlando, FL (World Showcase ring + front-of-park)
meta.description: Walkable navigation graph of Walt Disney World’s EPCOT: the World Showcase lagoon ring (11 pavilions + The Outpost), the World Showcase Bridge, the International Gateway, and the front-of-park hub (World Celebration, World Discovery, World Nature). Schematic model built for a DSA route-navigation demonstration — NOT survey data and NOT for real-world navigation.
meta.coordinateSystem: local 2-D grid in metres: origin at the centre of World Showcase Lagoon; x = east, y = north, z = elevation (flat park, z = 0 everywhere)
meta.scaleMethod: the lagoon promenade perimeter is documented as approximately 1.2 miles (≈1931 m) → promenade circle radius ≈ 1931/(2π) ≈ 307–312 m (R = 312 m used); pavilion angular positions read from the official 2026 park map (regular-spaced approximation, ±5–10°); front-of-park distances estimated from map proportions. Cross-check: reconstructed 13-segment ring perimeter = 1952 m vs documented ≈1931 m (+1.1%).
meta.precision: coordinates ±20–50 m (ring ±30 m angular); edge weights ±10–20% (ring segments ≤ straight-line chord of the promenade arc); all values approximate, none verified
meta.referenceDate: 2026 (official 2026 EPCOT park map as primary reference; pavilion set includes Canada, which replaced Spain in 2024)

sources.label: Official 2026 EPCOT park map (image; viewed as reference only, NOT embedded in this project)
sources.usedFor: pavilion identities, clockwise order, area placement (Discovery west / Nature east), bridge and International Gateway placement, front-of-park layout

sources.label: Official 2023 EPCOT park map (image; reference only, NOT embedded)
sources.usedFor: corroboration of the same layout and of World Discovery / World Nature attraction rosters (incl. Mission: SPACE, Journey Into Imagination with Figment)

sources.label: Walt Disney World park guides (wdwnt.com, bepreparedvacations.com, pixievacations.com, deeparrival.com)
sources.usedFor: corroborating the 2026 map layout, area names, attraction rosters

sources.label: Public historical park references (undercovertourist.com, dadsguidetowdw.com, howtodisney.com, theoriginalepcot site)
sources.usedFor: documented 11-pavilion World Showcase ordering (clockwise from the bridge: Mexico, Norway, China, Germany, Italy, America, Japan, Morocco, France, United Kingdom, Canada), documented ≈1.2-mile lagoon perimeter, Canada-replaced-Spain (2024), The Outpost history

assumptions: The lagoon is modelled as a circle; the real lake is kidney-shaped (documented approximation).
Pavilions sit on the promenade circle at angles read from the map; the exact spacing is not a surveyed value.

The bridge is the only walkable connection between the front-of-park hub and the World Showcase ring; the International Gateway is a separate external entrance and is NOT connected to the front-of-park side in this graph.
Edge weights are straight-line distances (ceil), an upper bound on the true walk length; ring segment lengths are additionally constrained by the documented perimeter.
Edges marked straight-line-approx model plausible direct links that are not individually verified (shortcuts between two attractions, pavilion-internal hops).
Elevation is flat (z = 0); the park has minor grade changes that are not modelled.
Opening hours, queues, seasonal closures and construction are out of scope (static topology).
